name: What factors influence the valuation of a luxury condo?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the valuation of a luxury condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury condo valuations are primarily influenced by location, building amenities, unit size, view, and recent comparable sales. High-end finishes, smart home technology, and exclusive services within the building also contribute significantly. For example, a beachfront property in Miami Beach will command a different value than a similar unit inland, due to its direct access and sought-after views. The specific appeal of a neighborhood, such as the cultural scene in Coconut Grove or the vibrant urban life in Brickell, also plays a crucial role in its overall market desirability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Factors influencing luxury condo valuation include location, amenities, unit size, view, finishes, and recent comparable sales.
